classes.name: Observation
classes.description: A typed observation retained from accepted source evidence. Required properties keep source evidence, problem signature, occurrence identifiers, classification, and disposition on the object.

properties.name: source_evidence
properties.description: Evidence submission id that authorized this observation.

properties.name: occurrence_ids
properties.description: Occurrence identifiers retained as a single string value.

classes.name: Finding
classes.description: A finding derived from one or more observations. It is a typed object, not a live investigation.

properties.name: observation_id
properties.description: Observation this finding is based on.

classes.name: InvestigationResult
classes.description: A measured investigation outcome. Distinct from a hypothesis and from a verification record.

properties.name: measured
properties.description: Whether the outcome is a measured fact.

classes.name: Hypothesis
classes.description: A proposed explanation. It is not a measured investigation result and cannot be the subject of the verification Action.

classes.name: ExternalIssueReference
classes.description: A reference to an issue in an external tracker. Adapters that write the tracker are outside this package.

classes.name: VerificationRecord
classes.description: A verification of a measured investigation result. The verification Action admits only subject_kind feedback_investigation_result.

relations.name: based_on
relations.description: A finding is based on an observation.

relations.name: investigates
relations.description: An investigation result investigates an observation.

relations.name: proposes_about
relations.description: A hypothesis proposes an explanation about an observation.

relations.name: tracks
relations.description: An external issue reference tracks a finding.

relations.name: verifies
relations.description: A verification record verifies a measured investigation result.

provenance.subject: Observation
provenance.locator: Acceptance: fixture observations retain source evidence and lineage

provenance.subject: Hypothesis
provenance.locator: Hypotheses are a separate type from measured investigation results

provenance.subject: VerificationRecord
provenance.locator: Verification Action subject_kind admits investigation results only

provenance.subject: verifies
provenance.locator: Issue-verification lineage stays on typed objects
